name: understand-figma
tagline_zh: 丢个 Figma 链接，自动拆解页面、组件、设计令牌，生成可点击的知识图谱。连嵌套实例和隐藏的 token 都给你。
tagline_en: Drop a Figma link, get an interactive design graph—pages, components, tokens, even nested instances unearthed.
desc_en: Analyze a Figma file via the Figma REST API and generate an interactive design knowledge graph (pages, screens, components, component sets, instances, design tokens) with a kind:"design" dashboard.
why_zh: 它不是简单列清单，而是把实例关系、token 依赖织成一张可探索的网，让你一眼看懂设计系统的真实结构。
why_en: Unlike flat lists, it weaves instance and token dependencies into a navigable graph, revealing the true design system structure.
